text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
What an incredible run, Fuji Kiseki! 
Man... a real monster has shown up.

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
I can't wait to see what they do next 
year! I wonder which circuit they'll 
pursue?

text_block_list.name: Interviewer
text_block_list.text:
A wonderful run to mark your debut 
victory! How are you feeling right now? 
Just a few words, please!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Thank you! I am honored that you enjoyed 
it.

text_block_list.name: Interviewer
text_block_list.text:
By the way... all of you might be 
wondering about this too.

text_block_list.name: Interviewer
text_block_list.text:
"What are your thoughts regarding your 
future goals at this point in time...?"

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
I'm glad you asked. What I aim for is 
indeed the royal road, yet a path of 
thorns—

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: “Triple Crown Umamusume”!

text_block_list.name: Reporters
text_block_list.text: Ooh...!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
"On that stage, I want to clash with 
talent, clash with threats, and clash with 
potential!"

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
And at the end of it, I want to seize it! 
The honor of being a Triple Crown 
Umamusume, a one-of-a-kind title!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
—I want to deliver the continuation of the 
dream sleeping there, what lies beyond the 
miracle, to you!

text_block_list.name: Interviewer
text_block_list.text:
I see...! I'm truly looking forward to 
your success!

Fuji Kiseki's passionate words seemed to 
ignite a fire under many reporters' pens—

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
"Fuji Kiseki Declares Classic Triple Crown 
Ambition: The Aspirations of This Year's 
Star Hopeful"

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Whoa, they wrote so much for us!

Articles and social media were filled with 
words expressing high hopes for Fuji 
Kiseki's future.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
"Did I hype things up a bit too much 
during the interview?"

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
No, but... that's the kind of thing I 
really want to do.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Expectations are like a tailwind. You've 
gotta hoist your sails and ride it!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Alright! Let's switch gears and think 
about the next race!

The next target race is a stage she must 
experience if she hopes to achieve the 
Classic Triple Crown—
choice_data_list:
What about the "Asahi Hai Futurity 
Stakes"?

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: I see, a Junior Class GⅠ race!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
I guess they want to get some big-stage 
experience under their belt now for next 
year, huh?

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Understood. First, let's take it one 
steady step at a time and do our best!

With the Asahi Hai Futurity Stakes set as 
our next target race, our days of 
dedicated training began!
